verses.en: Behold, thus saith the Lord your God unto you, O ye elders of my church, hearken ye and hear, and receive my will concerning you.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii lo outou Atua ia te outou, e outou e toeaina o la’u ekalesia, ia outou faalogo mai ma lagona, ma talia lo’u loto e faatatau ia te outou.

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, I will that ye should overcome the world; wherefore I will have compassion upon you.
verses.sm: Aua e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te loto ia outou manumalo i le lalolagi; o le mea lea o le a i ai lo’u agaalofa i luga o outou.

verses.en: There are those among you who have sinned; but verily I say, for this once, for mine own glory, and for the salvation of souls, I have forgiven you your sins.
verses.sm: E i ai ni isi o i latou o e o i totonu o outou ua agasala; ae e moni Ou te fai atu, i le taimi e tasi lenei, mo lo’u lava mamalu, ma mo le faaolataga o agaga, ua Ou faamagaloina outou ia outou agasala.

verses.en: I will be merciful unto you, for I have given unto you the kingdom.
verses.sm: O le a Ou alofa mutimutivale ia te outou, ona ua Ou tuu atu ia te outou le malo.

verses.en: And the keys of the mysteries of the kingdom shall not be taken from my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., through the means I have appointed, while he liveth, inasmuch as he obeyeth mine ordinances.
verses.sm: Ma o ki o mealilo o le malo, e ala i auala ua Ou tofia, o le a lē aveesea mai la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, a’o soifua o ia, e tusa ai ma lona usitaia o a’u sauniga.

verses.en: There are those who have sought occasion against him without cause;
verses.sm: Ua i ai ni isi o i latou o e ua latou saili ni mea e faasaga ia te ia e aunoa ma se pogai;

verses.en: Nevertheless, he has sinned; but verily I say unto you, I, the Lord, forgive sins unto those who confess their sins before me and ask forgiveness, who have not sinned unto death.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, sa agasala o ia; ae e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o A’u, o le Alii, Ou te faamagaloina agasala a i latou o e e ta’uta’u mai a latou agasala i o’u luma ma ole mai mo se faamagaloga, o e ia e lei agasala i le oti.

verses.en: My disciples, in days of old, sought occasion against one another and forgave not one another in their hearts; and for this evil they were afflicted and sorely chastened.
verses.sm: O o’u soo, i aso anamua, sa latou saili ni mea e faasaga i le tasi ma lē faamagalo i le isi i o latou loto; ma o lenei mea leaga na faapuapuagatia ma aoai mamafa tele ai i latou.

verses.en: Wherefore, I say unto you, that ye ought to forgive one another; for he that forgiveth not his brother his trespasses standeth condemned before the Lord; for there remaineth in him the greater sin.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, Ou te fai atu ai ia te outou, e tatau ona outou faamagalo i le tasi; ona o ia o lē e lē faamagalo atu i lona uso i ana agasala, e tu ta’usalaina o ia i luma o le Alii; aua e tumau ia te ia le agasala tele atu.

verses.en: I, the Lord, will forgive whom I will forgive, but of you it is required to forgive all men.
verses.sm: O A’u, o le Alii, Ou te faamagalo i lē o le a Ou faamagaloina, ae o outou ua poloaiina ia faamagalo atu i tagata uma.

verses.en: And ye ought to say in your hearts—let God judge between me and thee, and reward thee according to thy deeds.
verses.sm: Ma e tatau ona outou fai ifo i o outou loto— ia tuu i le Atua e faamasino i le va o a’u ma oe, ma taui ia te oe e tusa ma au galuega.

verses.en: And him that repenteth not of his sins, and confesseth them not, ye shall bring before the church, and do with him as the scripture saith unto you, either by commandment or by revelation.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e lē salamo i ana agasala, ma lē ta’uta’u atu i latou, ia outou aumai i luma o le ekalesia, ma fai ia te ia e pei ona fai mai tusitusiga paia ia te outou, pe ala i le poloaiga po o i le faaaliga.

verses.en: And this ye shall do that God may be glorified—not because ye forgive not, having not compassion, but that ye may be justified in the eyes of the law, that ye may not offend him who is your lawgiver—
verses.sm: Ma ia outou faia lenei mea ina ia faamamaluina ai le Atua— e lē ona ua outou lē faamagalo atu, ona ua leai so outou agaalofa, ae ina ia mafai ona ta’uamiotonu ai outou e tusa ai ma le tulafono, ina ia outou lē faatausuai ai ia te ia o lē o lo outou faitulafono—

w.en: And you shall do this thing

verses.en: Verily I say, for this cause ye shall do these things.
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu, o le pogai lenei ia outou faia ai ia mea.

verses.en: Behold, I, the Lord, was angry with him who was my servant Ezra Booth, and also my servant Isaac Morley, for they kept not the law, neither the commandment;
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, sa Ou ita ia te ia o lē sa avea ma a’u auauna, o Ezra Booth, ma la’u auauna foi o Isaako Morley, ona sa laua lē tausia le tulafono, po o le poloaiga;

verses.en: They sought evil in their hearts, and I, the Lord, withheld my Spirit. They condemned for evil that thing in which there was no evil; nevertheless I have forgiven my servant Isaac Morley.
verses.sm: Sa laua saili le leaga i o laua loto, ma o A’u, o le Alii, na taofia lo’u Agaga. Sa laua ta’u ua leaga lena mea sa leai se leaga na i ai; ae ui i lea, ua Ou faamagaloina la’u auauna o Isaako Morley.

verses.en: And also my servant Edward Partridge, behold, he hath sinned, and Satan seeketh to destroy his soul; but when these things are made known unto them, and they repent of the evil, they shall be forgiven.
verses.sm: Ma o la’u auauna foi o Eteuati Paterika, faauta, ua agasala o ia, ma ua saili Satani e faaumatia lona agaga; ae a faailoa atu nei mea ia te i latou, ma latou salamo ai i le leaga, o le a faamagaloina i latou.

verses.en: And now, verily I say that it is expedient in me that my servant Sidney Gilbert, after a few weeks, shall return upon his business, and to his agency in the land of Zion;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ua tatau ai ia te a’u ona toe foi atu o la’u auauna o Sini Gilbert, pe a mavae ni nai vaiaso, i lana pisinisi, ma i lona tofi o le sui i le laueleele o Siona;

verses.en: And that which he hath seen and heard may be made known unto my disciples, that they perish not. And for this cause have I spoken these things.
verses.sm: Ma o mea na vaai ma faalogo i ai o ia e mafai ona faailoa atu i o’u soo, ina ia lē fano i latou. Ma o le pogai lenei ua Ou tautala atu ai i nei mea.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, that my servant Isaac Morley may not be tempted above that which he is able to bear, and counsel wrongfully to your hurt, I gave commandment that his farm should be sold.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ina ia lē faaosoosoina la’u auauna o Isaako Morley e sili atu i luga o le mea e mafai ona ia gafatia, ma fautua sese atu ai i mea tou te tiga ai, na Ou tuu atu ai le poloaiga e tatau ona faatau atu lana faatoaga.

verses.en: I will not that my servant Frederick G. Williams should sell his farm, for I, the Lord, will to retain a strong hold in the land of Kirtland, for the space of five years, in the which I will not overthrow the wicked, that thereby I may save some.
verses.sm: Ou te lē loto ia faatau atu e la’u auauna o Feterika G. Viliamu lana faatoaga, ona o A’u, o le Alii, Ou te loto ia i ai pea se taofiga malosi i le laueleele o Katelani, mo le va o le lima tausaga, lea o le a Ou lē faatoilaloina ai e ua amioleaga, ina ia mafai ona Ou faaolaina ai ni isi.

verses.en: And after that day, I, the Lord, will not hold any guilty that shall go with an open heart up to the land of Zion; for I, the Lord, require the hearts of the children of men.
verses.sm: Ma a mavae lena aso, o A’u, o le Alii, o le a lē ta’usalaina soo se tasi e alu a’e ma le loto matala i le laueleele o Siona; ona o A’u, o le Alii, Ou te manaomia loto o le fanauga a tagata.

verses.en: Behold, now it is called today until the coming of the Son of Man, and verily it is a day of sacrifice, and a day for the tithing of my people; for he that is tithed shall not be burned at his coming.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua ta’ua nei o le asō seia oo i le afio mai o le Atalii o le Tagata, ma e moni o se aso o le taulaga, ma o se aso mo le totogiina o le sefuluai e lo’u nuu; ona o ia o lē ua totogi le sefuluai o le a lē mu i lona afio mai.

verses.en: For after today cometh the burning—this is speaking after the manner of the Lord—for verily I say, tomorrow all the proud and they that do wickedly shall be as stubble; and I will burn them up, for I am the Lord of Hosts; and I will not spare any that remain in Babylon.
verses.sm: Aua a mavae le aso o le a oo mai le mu— o le faamatalaga lenei e tusa ma le ala a le Alii— aua e moni Ou te fai atu, o taeao, o le a faapei o tagutugutu o saito i latou uma ua faamaualuluga ma i latou o e ua fai amioleaga; ma o le a Ou susunuina i latou, aua o A’u o le Alii o ‘Au; ma o le a Ou lē faasaoina soo se tasi e tumau i Papelonia.

verses.en: Wherefore, if ye believe me, ye will labor while it is called today.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, afai tou te talitonu mai ia te A’u, o le a outou galulue manū o ta’ua o le asō.

verses.en: And it is not meet that my servants, Newel K. Whitney and Sidney Gilbert, should sell their store and their possessions here; for this is not wisdom until the residue of the church, which remaineth in this place, shall go up unto the land of Zion.
verses.sm: Ma ua lē o se mea tatau i a’u auauna, o Newel K. Whitney ma Sini Gilbert, ona faatau atu lo la’ua faleoloa ma a la’ua mea ua maua, iinei; ona ua lē poto lena mea seia o a’e i le laueleele o Siona e o totoe o le ekalesia, o loo tumau pea i le nofoaga lenei.

verses.en: Behold, it is said in my laws, or forbidden, to get in debt to thine enemies;
verses.sm: Faauta, ua fai mai i a’u tulafono, pe ua faasaina, le ’aitalafu i o outou fili;

verses.en: But behold, it is not said at any time that the Lord should not take when he please, and pay as seemeth him good.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, ua lē o fai mai i soo se taimi e faapea e lē tatau i le Alii ona ia ave pe a ia finagalo i ai, ma totogi atu e pei ona lelei ia te ia.

verses.en: Wherefore, as ye are agents, ye are on the Lord’s errand; and whatever ye do according to the will of the Lord is the Lord’s business.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ona o oulua o sui, ua oulua o atu i le feau a le Alii; ma o soo se mea lua te faia e tusa ma le finagalo o le Alii o le matafaioi lea a le Alii.

verses.en: And he hath set you to provide for his saints in these last days, that they may obtain an inheritance in the land of Zion.
verses.sm: Ma ua ia faatutuina oulua e saunia mea mo lana au paia i aso nei e gata ai, ina ia mafai ona latou maua se tofi i le laueleele o Siona.

verses.en: And behold, I, the Lord, declare unto you, and my words are sure and shall not fail, that they shall obtain it.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, Ou te tautino atu ia te oulua, ma o a’u upu e mautinoa ma e lē i’uvale, o le a latou maua lava.

verses.en: But all things must come to pass in their time.
verses.sm: Peitai o le a oo mai mea uma i lo latou taimi.

verses.en: Wherefore, be not weary in well-doing, for ye are laying the foundation of a great work. And out of small things proceedeth that which is great.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, aua le faavaivai i le faia o mea lelei, ona o lo o oulua faataatiaina le faavae o se galuega tele. Ma e maimea iti e tutupu mai ai mea tetele.

verses.en: Behold, the Lord requireth the heart and a willing mind; and the willing and obedient shall eat the good of the land of Zion in these last days.
verses.sm: Faauta, e manaomia e le Alii le loto ma le mafaufau malie; ma o e e loto malilie ma usiusitai o le a aai i le lelei o le laueleele o Siona i aso nei e gata ai.

verses.en: And the rebellious shall be cut off out of the land of Zion, and shall be sent away, and shall not inherit the land.
verses.sm: Ma o e e fouvale o le a vavae ese mai le laueleele o Siona, ma o le a auina ese atu, ma o le a lē mautofi i le laueleele.

verses.en: For, verily I say that the rebellious are not of the blood of Ephraim, wherefore they shall be plucked out.
verses.sm: Aua, e moni Ou te fai atu o e e fouvale ua lē mai le toto o Efaraima, o le mea lea o le a aveeseina ai i latou.

verses.en: Behold, I, the Lord, have made my church in these last days like unto a judge sitting on a hill, or in a high place, to judge the nations.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou faia la’u ekalesia i aso nei e gata ai e faapei o se faamasino o loo nofo i luga o se mauga, po o se nofoaga maualuga, e faamasino atunuu.

verses.en: For it shall come to pass that the inhabitants of Zion shall judge all things pertaining to Zion.
verses.sm: Aua o le a oo mai o e o aumau i Siona o le a faamasino i mea uma e faatatau ia Siona.

verses.en: And liars and hypocrites shall be proved by them, and they who are not apostles and prophets shall be known.
verses.sm: Ma o e e pepelo ma faatagālelei o le a faamaonia e i latou, ma o i latou o e e lē o ni aposetolo ma perofeta o le a iloa.

verses.en: And even the bishop, who is a judge, and his counselors, if they are not faithful in their stewardships shall be condemned, and others shall be planted in their stead.
verses.sm: Ma e oo i le epikopo, o lē o se faamasino, ma ona fesoasoani, afai latou te lē faamaoni ia latou matafaioi o le a tausalaina, ma o le a tuu isi i o latou tulaga.

verses.en: For, behold, I say unto you that Zion shall flourish, and the glory of the Lord shall be upon her;
verses.sm: Aua, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou o le a tupu olaola Siona, ma o le a i ona luga le mamalu o le Alii;

verses.en: And she shall be an ensign unto the people, and there shall come unto her out of every nation under heaven.
verses.sm: Ma o le a avea o ia o se tagavai i le nuu, ma o le a o mai ia te ia tagata mai atunuu uma o i lalo o le lagi.

verses.en: And the day shall come when the nations of the earth shall tremble because of her, and shall fear because of her terrible ones. The Lord hath spoken it. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma e oo mai le aso o le a gatete ai atunuu uma o le lalolagi ona o ia, ma o le a matata’u ona o ona tagata matautia. Ua fetalai mai ai le Alii. Amene.
